name: - JAY
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to buyJayWithERC721, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a reentrancy exploit but not a trivial one: it uses a flash loan, multiple buy/sell cycles, and a crafted ERC721 transferFrom callback to reenter protocol logic. An auditor would need to understand the token sale flow and the NFT-handling path in buyJay/sell, making it more involved than a simple single-call reentrancy.
